title: Siblings with Doll Pram, Rooftop Play - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length vintage snapshot depicting two young siblings outdoors on what appears to be an urban rooftop or terrace. A young smiling girl in a floral summer playsuit and white buck shoes holds the handle of an antique woven wicker doll pram containing a baby doll. Beside her stands her brother dressed in summer shortalls over a collared shirt. Behind them is a rooftop bulkhead or doorway casting a deep shadow under bright midday sun, alongside a clothesline pole in the distance.
